name: World Of Rebus
detailed_description:
Looking for absorbing games that will train your wits?

  It's high time to rack your brain in the breathtaking puzzle World Of Rebus and take part in the detective story! Most of brain-training games are really boring but the puzzles represented in the game World Of Rebus will provoke you to escape from a daily routine and dive into a world of interesting but challenging riddles.

     John, the world-famous archeologist, found out that his little son Willie was kidnapped by criminals. A despaired father has to found the lost magic artifact for the notorious band as a ransom for his beloved son otherwise he won't ever see him again. So, it's time to hurry! John should travel around the world to find the parts of the broken magic amulet. Help John survive in the hot sands of endless desert, find the way in the gloomy forests and save him from drowning in the sea rush! Look through the tutorial and solve the numerous puzzles in the gripping game World Of Rebus. Don't forget the rules, mind that the commas near the word mean that letters at the end or at the beginning of the word shouldn't be read.

     There are lots of levels: logical brain-teasers, puzzles, where you are to reveal the new words and even uncommon sound riddles. Some of the puzzles will be really undertaking, that's why you are provided with hints. Use them when you are stuck and do your best to cope with all the tasks as quickly as possible! Help John find all parts of the broken amulet and get numerous achievements! Indonesia, China, Tibet, hot deserts, and even the North Pole - examine all these locations, find the ancient artifact and help John return his son!
